newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ govt Feb 2001 bonds yield 7.35 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ govt Feb 2001 bonds yield 7.35 pct at tender.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Thursday its offer of NZ$100 million of February 2001 bonds yielded an average 7.35 percent.
In a previous tender on April 11, $100 million of the same bonds yielded an average 8.225 percent.
There was only one successful bidder in Thursday's tender.
The bonds have an eight percent coupon, and the settlement date is May 20.
